Results.ReviewText:
I distinctly remember the day I purchased my Weber Original Kettle 22’ grill.  It was July 19, 1996 the opening day of the Atlanta 1996 Summer Olympics.  I lived in the Atlanta area at the time and the day was one of high expectations and excitement for us residents.  I purchased the Weber for a cookout celebration with friends and family to watch the opening ceremonies.  To say my Weber grill ended up being an Olympic Champion would be an understatement!

This utilitarian but impressive grill has performed exceptionally for 26 ½ years and has NEVER let me down. For the first 20 years I used the grill at least once a week with many times being twice a week.  More recently as my children grew and we became empty nesters our use went down to about once a month.  I am amazed to calculate an estimate of the total number of meals I have cooked on my Weber.  Once a week for 20 years plus once a month for 5 ½ is over 1,100 total!!  I am proud to report my Weber has served me well for somewhere between 500 & 1,100 barbeques per my estimates.  I don't know the exact total of times I have used this Weber but stats like this are Olympian Champion level performance. 

There has been little maintenance required for this exceptional performance.  I have replaced the upper grill once or twice and the bolts securing the vents to the kettle needed to be removed and replaced.  The unit has always been protected from rain with a cover or a roof so rust was never an issue.  

Eventually I will need to replace this grill as I am now seeing some corrosion in the metal near the lower part of the kettle where the heat is most intense.  Last week I was strolling the grill aisle of my local Big Box home store where I saw other charcoal grills priced @ the entry level of $499 up to $1,800+.  I can only laugh knowing I may have paid $65 for my Original Kettle 22” in 1996 and can get another one today for only $139 that will likely outlast me and any remaining grilling days I have left on this earth!  Considering that I am Sold…

RJ the GrandMaster
Results.Title: Olympic Champion Performance
